gloss: Noble sutra named: dharmatā's own nature, not moving from the very nature of emptiness, appearing distinctly to all
why: Renders the Tibetan title chos nyid rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid las mi g.yo bar tha dad par thams cad la snang ba'i mdo term by term, in order: dharmatā (nom-un činar), own nature, emptiness (qoγosun), unmoving (ködelüsi ügei), distinctly (öber-e öber-e), to all (qamuγ-dur), appearing/shown (üjegülkü), sutra

gloss: Great tantra king named the accomplished sole hero
why: A sole-hero (ekavīra) tantra title; (A) is the Dharmatāsvabhāva sutra and has no tantra, hero, or accomplishment content

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sutra named Gayāśīrṣa mountain
why: Gayāśīrṣa does not appear in (A); (A) is the Prajñāpāramitā-naya 150-line text

gloss: Noble Perfection of Wisdom in eight thousand (lines)
why: Title of the Aṣṭasāhasrikā; (A) contains the end of the Caturdharmaka and the Caturniḥsāraka sutra and has no 'eight thousand' or prajñāpāramitā title

gloss: King of tantras named vajra accomplishing the three places
why: A vajra/tantra title; (A) is the Ratnakoṭi sutra and has no vajra, 'three places', or tantra content

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra named 'Great Powerful' (yeke küčütü)
why: The title 'Great Powerful' corresponds to Mahābala (stobs po che), not to (A)'s Mañjuśrī-paripṛcchā ('asked by Mañjuśrī'). (A)'s later 'mthu che ba' describes the cakravartin and is not a title.

gloss: ...bodhi-heart's (bodhimaṇḍa) ten-myriad ornament ... dhāraṇī
why: There is no bodhimaṇḍa-ornament or dhāraṇī title in (A). (A) has the Samādhicakra colophon and the Pariṇatacakra sūtra title.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra named 'Good Era' (sayin čaγ)
why: 'Sayin čaγ' renders bskal pa bzang po (Bhadrakalpika), which is (A)'s title: 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo.

gloss: ...asked (öčigsen), named Mahāyāna sūtra
why: 'Asked' (paripṛcchā) is not in the title in (A), which is Mahābala, 'stobs po che'. The rest of (B) is the stock 'named Mahāyāna sūtra'.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Buddha-field' (burqan-u oron)
why: (A)'s title is the Āṭānāṭiya sūtra (lcang lo can gyi pho brang), with no Buddha-field title. The rest of (B) is a stock formula.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Asked by Sāgara, King of the Nāgas'
why: The title is Sāgaranāgarājaparipṛcchā. (A) is the Amoghapāśahṛdaya; no nāga king Sāgara appears there, and the rest is a stock title formula.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Wheel of Complete Intent/Resolve'
why: 'oγoγata joriqu-yin kürdün' (wheel of complete resolve) does not correspond to (A)'s Bodhigarbhālaṅkāralakṣa dhāraṇī or to anything in its colophon; only the stock title frame is shared.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Buddha-ground (Buddhabhūmi)'
why: 'burqan-u oron kemegdekü yeke kölgen sudur' renders the title in (A), 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo, in order.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Heart of the Unfailing (Amogha) Noose'
why: 'tusatu salm-a-yin jirüken' = don yod zhags pa'i snying po (Amoghapāśa-hṛdaya), which is (A)'s title, followed by the 'called… Mahāyāna sūtra' frame.

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra, chapter called 'Gate from All Sides'
why: 'qamuγ-ača qaγalγ-a neretü bölüg' = kun nas sgo'i le'u (Samantamukha-parivarta), the title of the new text that begins in (A).

gloss: The noble [text] named 'Noose of Means, Lotus Garland'
why: Title of the Upāyapāśa Padmamālā; (A) contains the end of the Dharmamudrā and the start of the Pradīpadānīya (lamp-offering) sūtra, with no noose or lotus garland.

gloss: Noble Perfection of Wisdom in a hundred and fifty modes
why: Title of the Adhyardhaśatikā Prajñāpāramitā; (A) is the Gayāśīrṣa sūtra, with no 150-line Prajñāpāramitā title.

gloss: Sūtra of the palace (ordo qarsi) of Āṭānāṭa
why: Corresponds to (A)'s title ཨཱ་ཊཱ་ནཱ་ཊི་ཡ་སཱུ་ཏྲ / ལྕང་ལོ་ཅན་གྱི་ཕོ་བྲང་གི་མདོ: the Āṭānāṭa name plus 'palace' plus 'sūtra', in order.

gloss: Tantra named 'Union of the Four Yoginīs'
why: Caturyoginīsaṃpuṭa title; (A) is the Vimalaśraddhā-paripṛcchā (Ratnakūṭa ch. 40), with no four yoginīs or saṃpuṭa.

gloss: The noble [text] named 'Noose of Means, Lotus Garland'
why: Matches (A)'s title འཕགས་པ་ཐབས་ཀྱི་ཞགས་པ་པདྨོའི་ཕྲེང་ཞེས་བྱ་བ: qutuγ-tu = noble, arγ-a = means, čalm-a = noose, lingqu-a erike = lotus garland, neretü = named.

gloss: Holy ... the Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Asked by the girl of pure faith'
why: (B) is a sūtra title about a girl of pure faith. (A) here is the Caturyoginīsampuṭa tantra title and verses; there is no girl, no faith and no 'asked' sūtra.

gloss: The sūtra of the palace of Alakavatī
why: (A) mentions a great palace (gzhal med khang chen po), but the name Alakavatī (Adaγavandi) does not occur. (A) is the Buddhabhūmi sūtra, so the specific content does not correspond.

gloss: ...'s Asked, the Mahāyāna sūtra called
why: 'üčigsen neretü yeke külgen sudur' matches the title ending '...gyis dris pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo' (Mañjuśrīparipṛcchā). The name Mañjuśrī is missing, and the rest is a stock title formula.

gloss: Holy Acala's tantra-king (of realization)
why: (B) is a title for an Acala tantra. (A) is the Bhadrakalpika sūtra, and Acala does not appear in it.

gloss: ...'s supreme; one fascicle
why: 'tegedü nigen keseg' corresponds in order to 'ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa / bam po gcig go' in the Samādhyagrottama title.

gloss: Called 'Compendium of all rtog-pa', union equal with all buddhas, ḍākinī net, supreme bliss, the later of the later tantra
why: Matches the title in A: rtog pa thams cad 'dus pa (qamuγ onol quriyaγsan), sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba (qamuγ burqan luγ-a tegsi barilduγči), mkha' 'gro sgyu ma (dakini jali), bde ba'i mchog (jirγalang-un degedü), rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma (qoyitu yin qoyitu dandra), in order.

gloss: Called 'Compendium of all rtog-pa', union equal with all buddhas, ḍākinī net, supreme bliss, later of later tantra
why: This is the Ḍākinījāla-saṃvara uttarottara tantra title. A is the end of the Rāṣṭrapāla chapter and the opening of the Ugraparipṛcchā; none of this content appears in A.

gloss: Noble 'Asked by Sāgara, king of nāgas', a Mahāyāna sūtra
why: Matches the title 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo: the name Sāgara (saγara), nāga king (luus-un qaγan), asked (öčigsen), Mahāyāna sūtra (yeke kölgen sudur).

gloss: Noble 'Mountain Gayā-head', a Mahāyāna sūtra
why: Matches the title 'phags pa ga yā mgo'i ri zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo: gaya terigün-ü aγulan = ga yā mgo'i ri, followed by neretü yeke kölgen sudur.

gloss: ...of the upper/supreme, one part/section
why: Only a genitive suffix plus 'degedü nigen keseg', a generic section or volume marker. No name or distinctive term matching the Kālī dhāraṇī or stotra in A.

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Asked by the Fierce Mighty One'
why: Title of the next text in (A): 'phags pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa ... theg pa chen po'i mdo; doγsin kücütü renders drag shul can (Ugra) and üčigsen renders zhus pa, in order; 'householder' is omitted

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Of the Good Time'
why: (A) is the Acala tantra (mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po); nothing about a 'good/auspicious time' and it is not a Mahāyāna sūtra title; only the stock title frame is shared

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Asked by the Fierce Mighty One'
why: (A) is the end of a Ḍākinī/Saṃvara tantra and the start of its uttara-tantra; there is no Ugra and no 'asked by'; only the stock title frame is shared

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Wheel of Complete Dedication'
why: Matches the title 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo: oγoγada jorigu = yongs su bsngo ba, kürdün = 'khor lo, in order

gloss: The noble Perfection of Wisdom in eight thousand
why: Matches the title 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa: bilig-ün činadu kürügsen = prajñāpāramitā, naiman mingγ-a = eight thousand

gloss: [Tantra] of the king of praises of the Glorious Black Goddess
why: Corresponds to the D671 title 'dpal lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa rgyal po'i rgyud': glorious (čoγtai = dpal), black goddess (qara ökin tngri = lha mo nag mo), praise (maγtaγal = bstod pa), king (qaγan = rgyal po), tantra (dandr-a = rgyud), in order.

gloss: Noble sūtra of the Great Vehicle named Great Strength
why: Corresponds to the D757 title 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo (Ārya Mahābala): yeke küčütü = stobs po che, neretü = zhes bya ba, yeke kölgen sudur = theg pa chen po'i mdo.

gloss: Sūtra that tells how death comes about (?)
why: Life-span or death content is not in (A). (A) has the colophon of the Daśadharmaka and the opening of the Samantamukhaparivarta; neither title matches.

gloss: Noble sūtra teaching, without moving from the true nature of dharmas and of emptiness, manifestation everywhere in various ways
why: Dharmatā/emptiness and 'showing everywhere' content does not appear in (A), which is the Ekavīra tantra with hail-stopping mantras.

gloss: Tantra named the Union (Saṃpuṭa) of the Four Yoginīs
why: Corresponds to the D376 title 'rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud ces bya ba' (Catur-yoginī-saṃpuṭa-tantra): dörben = bzhi, yoginis = rnal 'byor ma, qabsuldqui = kha sbyor, ündüsün = rgyud, neretü = ces bya ba.

gloss: Ārya 'Four Accomplishments' named Mahāyāna sūtra
why: Corresponds to the title འཕགས་པ་བཞི་པ་སྒྲུབ་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ: qutuγ-tu = ārya, dörben bütügel = bzhi pa sgrub pa, neretü yeke kölgen sudur = zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo

gloss: [Mahāyāna sūtra] named 'Ornament of the light of wisdom that causes entry into the domain'
why: Corresponds to the title ...ཡུལ་ལ་འཇུག་པའི་ཡེ་ཤེས་སྣང་བའི་རྒྱན་ཅེས་བྱ་བ་ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ: orosiγulqui = 'jug pa, belge bilig-ün gegen čimeg = ye shes snang ba'i rgyan; 'ai' is likely a garbled ayimaγ/oron (yul)

gloss: Sūtra asking how the passing away of life comes about
why: Corresponds to the title ཚེ་འཕོ་བ་ཇི་ལྟར་འགྱུར་བ་ཞུས་པའི་མདོ: nasun ögedkel = tshe 'pho ba, yambar bolqu = ji ltar 'gyur ba, öčigsen sudur = zhus pa'i mdo

gloss: Ārya 'Jewel Border' named Mahāyāna sūtra
why: The title 'jewel border' does not appear in A; A's title is the tantra རྡོ་རྗེ་ས་གསུམ་དུ་རྒྱུ་བ་རྟོག་པའི་རྒྱལ་པོ, and the rest of B is only a stock title formula

gloss: Praise of the glorious black maiden goddess; dhāraṇī of the ... king
why: No black goddess, praise, or dhāraṇī appears in A; A covers the end of the Four Youths Samādhi sūtra and the Samādhi-agrottama

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Four bödügel'
why: A title formula with 'four' (dörben) plus an unclear noun; A is the Aṣṭasāhasrikā ('eight thousand'), so neither the number nor the title fits. Only the stock title frame is shared.

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Offering of Lamps'
why: zula ergügsen = mar me 'bul ba (Pradīpadānīya), the title of the sūtra that begins in A.

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Edge of the Jewel'
why: erdeni-yin kijaγar = rin po che'i mtha' (Ratnakoṭi), the title in A.

gloss: The great king of tantras called 'Accomplished Sole Hero'
why: bütügsen γaγča baγatur = dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa (Siddhaekavīra); yeke dandra-yin qaγan = rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po.

gloss: The noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Gate from all', chapter of ...
why: The title content ('gate from all' / chapter) does not correspond to the Āyuḥsūtra or to 'How death and rebirth occur' in A; only the stock title frame is shared.

gloss: Glorious Fierce Vajra Heart's Secret, Later Tantra
why: Renders the title dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma: čoγtu (dpal), doγšin wčir (rdo rje gtum po), jirüken-ü niγuča (thugs gsang ba), qoyitu dandra (rgyud phyi ma), in order

gloss: Noble Acala's Kalpa, King of Tantras
why: Renders the title 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po: qutuγ-tu (ārya), Ačala (mi g.yo ba), onol (kalpa/rtog pa), ündüsün-ü qaγan (tantra king)

gloss: Noble Perfection of Wisdom in One Hundred Fifty Modes
why: Renders the title 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa: bilig-ün činadu kijaγar-a kürügsen (prajñāpāramitā), jaγun tabin (150), yosutu (tshul)

gloss: Kalpa-king named 'Vajra Moving in the Three Lands'
why: Renders the title rdo rje sa gsum du rgyu ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po: wčir (vajra), γurban γajar (sa gsum), moving-in (bidügči, likely a garbled yabuγči), neretü (zhes bya ba), onol-un qaγan (kalpa king)

gloss: Mahāyāna sūtra named 'Ornament of the Light of Wisdom, Establishing ...'
why: This is a different title (jñānāloka-alaṃkāra sūtra type: belge bilig-ün gegen čimeg, yeke külgen sudur). It does not match the Vajracaṇḍa tantra or anything else in (A)

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Offering of Lamps' (qutuγ-tu jula ergügsen neretü yeke kölgen sudur)
why: Title formula only; 'lamp offering' does not correspond to the title in (A), 'Lotus Garland of the Noose of Means' (thabs kyi zhags pa padmo'i phreng)

gloss: Glorious ... Vajra-heart secret later tantra
why: (A) is the Sarvabuddhaviṣayāvatāra-jñānālokālaṃkāra sūtra; no vajra-heart or later tantra appears in it

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Heart of ... salma' (garbled)
why: (A) is the sūtra Requested by the Nāga King Sāgara; there is no nāga king or ocean (dalai) in (B), and 'heart' does not fit that title

gloss: Dhāraṇī of the hundred-thousand ornaments of the Bodhi-heart
why: Corresponds to the title in (A), byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs (Bodhigarbhālaṅkāralakṣa dhāraṇī): bodhi-heart, 100,000 (arban tümen), ornament, dhāraṇī

gloss: Noble Mahāyāna sūtra called 'Requested by the girl of pure faith'
why: Corresponds to the title in (A), 'phags pa bu mo rnam dag dad pas zhus pa: girl (ökin), pure (ariγun), faith (bisirel), asked (öčigsen)
